gui.signbuilder.lcd.vars_help.tooltip:
Variables:
{time} → Game Time (12:00)
{weather} → Weather
{player} → Nearest Player
{day} → Day Number
{online} → Online Players
{coords} / {x} {y} {z} → Coordinates
{biome} → Biome Name
{moon} → Moon Phase
{fps} → Client FPS
{health} / {hp} → Player Health

Color Codes:
&0-&f, &l (Bold), &o (Italic), &r (Reset)
&#RRGGBB or <#RRGGBB> (Hex Color)
